title: Audio comparison viewer
responsibility: Opens paired recordings in a modal for listening to either side or both.

inputs.name: AudioComparisonViewer.before
inputs.description: Required before recording, used in before and comparison views.

inputs.name: AudioComparisonViewer.after
inputs.description: Required after recording, used in after/comparison views and as the comparison title.

inputs.name: AudioComparisonViewer.assetBase
inputs.description: Required URL prefix passed to each audio card for its file.

inputs.name: AudioComparisonViewer.onclose
inputs.description: Required callback called after the attached dialog is closed natively, allowing focus to return to its opener.

outputs.name: AudioComparisonViewer
outputs.description: Open audio modal initially in compare mode with Before/After/Compare controls. Mount pauses all document audio. Keyed audio cards are destroyed when leaving view, so their cleanup pauses playback. Each retains its own transcript, availability and status.
